scope: Restricted top-level getter/setter type changes with class-version relinking on host ARM64
observations: Changing getter return and setter parameter types from int to num versions the property wrapper and moves both helpers into the module.
Main and retained callers rebind; global storage and baseline AOT binary remain unchanged.
Independent original-source AOT matches mixed execution on both sides: first:2/after:3 and first:2.5/after:3.5.
A separate direct public function signature change exits nonzero and produces no module file in the regression test.
failed_attempts: The initial exploratory candidate also changed retained() from int to num and was rejected with Signature changed; its run and log remain under failed_direct_signature_probe. The final accepted fixture preserves that function signature.
not_accepted: Full M1 language/runtime compatibility and the historical native suite were not rerun.
Flutter cold-start activation, Android/iOS physical-device execution, signing, rollback and performance gates remain unverified.
Broader accessor type relationships and mixed language-version boundaries need separate validation.
